title: Rethinking Entropy Allocation in LLM-based ASR: Understanding the Dynamics between Speech Encoders and LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.08003v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Integrating large language models (LLMs) into automatic speech recognition (ASR) has become a dominant paradigm. Although recent LLM-based ASR models have shown promising performance on public benchmarks, it remains challenging to balance recognition quality with latency and overhead, while hallucinations further limit real-world deployment. In this study, we revisit LLM-based ASR from an entropy allocation perspective and introduce three metrics to characterize how training paradigms allocate entropy reduction between the speech encoder and the LLM. To remedy entropy-allocation inefficiencies in prevailing approaches, we propose a principled multi-stage training strategy grounded in capability-boundary awareness, optimizing parameter efficiency and hallucination robustness. translated_title: 重新思考基于大语言模型的语音识别中的熵分配：理解语音编码器与大语言模型之间的动态关系
translated_abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）集成到自动语音识别（ASR）中已成为一种主流范式。尽管近期的基于LLM的ASR模型在公开基准测试中表现出色，但在平衡识别质量与延迟和开销方面仍具有挑战性，而幻觉问题进一步限制了其实际部署。在本研究中，我们从熵分配的视角重新审视基于LLM的ASR，并引入三个指标来刻画训练范式如何在语音编码器与LLM之间分配熵的降低。为了解决现有方法中熵分配低效的问题，我们提出了一种基于能力边界感知的原则性多阶段训练策略，以优化参数效率和幻觉鲁棒性。具体而言，我们重新设计了预训练策略以缓解语音与文本模态之间的差距，并进一步引入了一种迭代异步的SFT阶段……
tldr: 该研究从熵分配的视角重新审视基于大语言模型的语音识别，提出了一种基于能力边界感知的多阶段训练策略，通过重新设计预训练以弥合语音-文本模态差距并引入迭代异步SFT，从而优化参数效率并增强幻觉鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This work re-examines LLM-based ASR from an entropy allocation perspective, introducing metrics to characterize entropy reduction between speech encoders and LLMs, and proposes a capability-boundary-aware multi-stage training strategy with redesigned pretraining and iterative asynchronous SFT to optimize parameter efficiency and hallucination robustness.
